sources.entry: Group Office - Enterprise CRM and groupware tool. Share projects, calendars, files and e-mail online with co-workers and clients. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Group Office is an open-source groupware and CRM platform for enterprises and the public sector, self-hosted or run on Intermesh's cloud.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes an integrated suite covering file sharing, video conferencing, e-mail, calendar and contact management, project and time tracking, quoting and invoicing, support ticketing, and the Collabora Online office suite. It is presented as a single platform that replaces several separate systems. The software can be extended with custom modules. The README points to a Docker image for production use and a docker compose project for development. It also gives manual source-install steps: clone with submodules, run a build script that compiles SASS, installs Composer packages and builds the GOUI TypeScript modules, then symlink the source tree and finish in the browser-based installer.
use_cases: share files and calendars with co-workers
how_to_run: Install PHP Composer, SASS and npm before building
Symlink the www directory of the clone to the install location (e.g. /usr/share/groupoffice)
Open the web browser and follow the installer instructions
Docker: use the production image or the development docker compose project (commands not given in README)
notable: Combines email, calendar, files, CRM, invoicing and ticketing in one platform
Can be self-hosted or run on Intermesh's cloud infrastructure
Developer setup includes Docker compose and a build script
caveats: Manual source install requires several tools (Composer, SASS, npm) and a Debian package setup step
Debian APT repository must be disabled manually to avoid overwrites on update
README gives no explicit docker command lines or image names
